name: World's Greatest Stretch
instructions: Step forward into a deep lunge with back leg extended.
Place both hands inside front foot.
Take inside hand and rotate chest up towards ceiling reaching for the sky.
Return hand, sit back slightly to stretch front hamstring, step forward and switch.
coachTips: Opens all major joints: hips, thoracic spine, groin, and ankles in one flow.
breathingTip: Exhale as you twist toward ceiling; inhale as hand returns.
progressionNote: Spend 2 full breaths in the thoracic twist.

name: Cat-Cow Stretch
instructions: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders, knees under hips.
Cow: Inhale, drop belly toward floor, lift chest and gaze up.
Cat: Exhale, round spine up towards ceiling, tuck chin and tailbone.
commonMistakes: Bending elbows instead of moving spine
coachTips: Move slowly vertebra by vertebra to lubricate spinal discs.
breathingTip: Deep breath in on Cow; complete empty exhale on Cat.
progressionNote: Synchronize breath fluidly with spinal movement.

name: Thoracic Spine Rotations (Open Books)
instructions: Lie on your side with hips and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Arms outstretched together on floor in front of chest.
Sweep top arm up and across like opening a book, following hand with your eyes.
Reach back until shoulder touches floor, hold for 1 second, return.
commonMistakes: Allowing knees to lift apart off the floor
coachTips: Keep knees clamped tightly together so movement stays in upper back.
breathingTip: Exhale as you open chest wide; inhale returning.

name: Deep Squat Pry & Hold
instructions: Squat down into the lowest possible comfortable squat position.
Place elbows inside knees and press palms together in prayer position.
Gently pry knees apart with elbows, shifting weight slightly side to side.
coachTips: Hold onto a doorframe or pole if your ankles are tight.
progressionNote: Gradually progress to freestanding hold with flat heels.

name: 90/90 Hip Mobility Flow
instructions: Sit on floor with lead leg bent at 90 degrees in front and trail leg bent at 90 degrees to side.
Hinge torso over front shin keeping spine long.
Rotate knees smoothly across to switch sides without hands on floor.
coachTips: Restores rotational freedom in hips to relieve lower back stiffness.
breathingTip: Inhale tall, exhale leaning into stretch.
progressionNote: Perform hands-free transitions as mobility improves.

name: Wrist Flexor & Extensor Mobility
instructions: On hands and knees, place palms flat with fingers pointed forward.
Rock gently forward and back.
Rotate fingers backwards toward knees, rocking gently to stretch flexors.
commonMistakes: Applying harsh force onto stiff wrists
coachTips: Essential prep before heavy benching, pushups, or front squats.
progressionNote: Perform before every upper body session.

name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Knee-to-Wall
instructions: Kneel in half-kneeling stance facing a wall with toes 4 inches away.
Drive front knee straight forward over middle toe until knee touches wall.
Keep heel glued to the floor throughout.
Hold for 1 second and return.
commonMistakes: Allowing heel to peel off floor
coachTips: Fixes limited ankle mobility that causes heels to lift in squats.
breathingTip: Exhale on knee drive; inhale returning.
progressionNote: Move foot 1/2 inch further back from wall as mobility expands.
